response.justification: Despite extensive software experience, the candidate is overqualified and misaligned with the junior role, lacks demonstrable Java project experience in recent roles, and has only basic German proficiency — a hard requirement for client-facing consulting work in Germany.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong track record in agile practices, TDD, CI/CD, and open-source contributions
Demonstrated ability to lead, teach, and build developer tooling and infrastructure
concerns: No recent Java projects listed; primary stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang
German proficiency is only basic, failing to meet required communication standards
Senior-level experience makes this a misfit for an entry-level role with limited budget
